Power only Pi once; report whether it starts and DC voltage directly from OUTPUT 8 (+) to OUTPUT 4 (ground). If startup fails, unplug it.

power_only_diagnostic_preparation.state: Owner describes complete series wiring with Pi off, including OUTPUT 8 source connection. Fresh DC/path checks not reported. Adjusted unpowered check asks to remove only OUTPUT 8 wire end; no powered trial instructed.
power_only_diagnostic_preparation.purpose: Separate the verified J2507 supply path from all SPI/clip contacts, with a series resistor bounding current instead of repeating direct connected startup failures.
power_only_diagnostic_preparation.candidate_topology: Final candidate: converter OUTPUT 8 -> measured 99 ohm series resistor -> J2507 pin 8 / blue VCC; converter OUTPUT 4 -> J2507 pin 2 / purple ground. Current requested stage leaves the OUTPUT 8 jumper loose for an unambiguous series-path resistance check. Clip/cable completely removed from converter OUTPUT and off router; other board leads free.
power_only_diagnostic_preparation.power_constraints: Router own power/cables/battery remain disconnected, cooling off. Pi power unplugged and residual voltage absent for wiring changes. No higher voltage, second supply, RESET resistor, SPI action or flash read/write.
power_only_diagnostic_preparation.interpretation_limit: A reduced rail voltage under a deliberate series limit is not by itself proof of a short or failed component; this would be a loading measurement, not a qualified programming supply.

source_context.observed: Flashrom documentation notes that supply through flash VCC can partially power other chipset circuitry when the SPI bus is insufficiently isolated.
source_context.scope: General mechanism only, not a diagnosis of A or authorization to apply the document's normal-board-power/reset suggestions. The proposed resistor diagnostic is separately reasoned for the known A setup.
